title: Multi-character and multi-reference mapping
prompt: Create a production-ready 12-second AI-video prompt. Images 1-2 are two views of Mara's identity and green courier coat; Image 3 is Ivo's identity and gray mechanic uniform; Image 4 is only the train-platform geometry and wet-night lighting; Video 1 is only the timing and left-to-right path of a suitcase handoff; Audio 1 is Mara's voice and Audio 2 is Ivo's voice. Mara begins frame left holding exactly one brass case in her right hand; Ivo begins frame right. Mara says, "You were late." Ivo says, "I came anyway." End with the case on the bench between them and both hands visible. Do not let any identity, background, wardrobe, composition, or audio role leak between references.
